meta.name: antinet-four-color-cards
meta.description: 基于解析后的文档与用户意图，生成四色卡片——事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡，是八官署方法论的核心分析输出。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档内容拆成事实、解释、风险、行动四类卡片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在阅读资料后快速提炼出事实要点、潜在风险与可执行行动。
copy.tagline_en: Turn documents into fact, explanation, risk, and action cards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn reading notes into facts, risks, and next steps.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把解析好的文档和你的意图变成四张卡:蓝卡列可溯源的事实,绿卡解释机制,黄卡标风险和过度声明,红卡给行动建议;每张卡都留痕可溯源。
howto.when: 当输入包含解析后的 markdown 文档和用户意图时触发,用于生成蓝、绿、黄、红四色卡片。

say.text: 请把这份 markdown 生成四色卡片:事实、解释、风险、行动。
say.note: 生成完整四卡,风险卡会交监察院复核。

say.text: 帮我分析这份文档,先出蓝卡和绿卡。
来源不全,生成卡片时请标注无来源。
say.note: 蓝卡不产生断言,只标无来源。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude converts the parsed document and your intent into four cards: blue (facts with sources), green (explanations), yellow (risks/overclaims), red (actions). Cards are traceable.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a parsed markdown document and a user intent are provided, and four-card analysis is needed.

say_en.text: Please generate four color cards from this markdown.
say_en.note: Produces all four cards; the risk card is reviewed.

say_en.text: Help me analyze this document, starting with blue and green cards.
say_en.note: Runs extract and review stages only.

say_en.text: Sources are incomplete; mark cards that lack sources.
say_en.note: Blue card will not assert claims without a source.
